number.why: The counts 61/180 versus 75/180 are supported, but SERVED_CONFIRMED is not justified for the served in-hospital/index-admission timepoint. The registry explicitly specifies postoperative AF incidence at 3 months; the abstract does not establish an in-hospital subset. The reported effect is an absolute difference with a 95% CI, not a published RR. The abstract also does not explicitly label these counts intention-to-treat.
